options.option: Scan national ID card at a kiosk

tasks.title: Visit: patient checks in with name and reason
tasks.goal: As a patient, I can check in with my name and reason so that I get a Visit number and a place in the Queue.
tasks.demoStep: Step 1: Check-in screen -> patient submits name and reason -> sees Visit number A-001.
acceptance: Given the check-in page, when the patient submits name "Jan Kowalski" and reason "Ból gardła", then a Visit with status WAITING and number A-001 is stored and the page shows "A-001"
Given one Visit checked in today, when another patient checks in, then the new Visit gets number A-002
Given an empty name, when the patient submits, then the response is 400 with "Popraw błędy w formularzu." and no Visit is stored

frontend: Page `/check-in` with the form using the generated `useCreateVisit` hook
Confirmation view showing the Visit number

tasks.title: Queue: doctor calls the next waiting visit
tasks.goal: As a doctor, I can call the next Visit so that patients are seen in check-in order.
tasks.demoStep: Step 2: Doctor screen -> click "Wezwij następnego" -> the oldest WAITING Visit becomes CALLED.
acceptance: Given Visits A-001 and A-002 in status WAITING, when the doctor calls next, then A-001 becomes CALLED and A-002 stays WAITING
Given no WAITING Visits, when the doctor calls next, then the response is 404 with "Brak pacjentów w kolejce." and the page shows that message

backend: `POST /api/v1/queue/call-next` -> `VisitResponse` of the called Visit, ordered by `checkedInAt`
frontend: Page `/doctor` with the "Wezwij następnego" button and the called Visit number

tasks.title: Queue: urgent visits are called before regular ones
tasks.goal: As a nurse, I can mark a Visit urgent so that it is called before regular Visits.
tasks.demoStep: Step 3: Nurse screen -> mark A-003 urgent -> doctor calls next -> A-003 is called.
acceptance: Given regular A-001 and later urgent A-003, when the doctor calls next, then A-003 becomes CALLED
Given urgent A-003 and later urgent A-004, when the doctor calls next twice, then A-003 is called first and A-004 second
Given a CALLED Visit, when the nurse marks it urgent, then the response is 409 with "Nie można oznaczyć wezwanej wizyty jako pilnej."

frontend: Page `/nurse` listing WAITING Visits with a "Pilne" button per row

tasks.title: Delivery: seed the demo Visits on the deployed app
tasks.goal: As the presenter, I can reset the app to the demo state so that the demo runs the same every time.
tasks.demoStep: All steps: the demo starts from the seeded Visits A-001 to A-003.
acceptance: Given the deployed app, when `./scripts/seed-demo.sh` runs, then the Queue contains exactly Visits A-001, A-002, A-003 in status WAITING

tasks.title: Queue: patient sees the estimated waiting time
tasks.goal: As a patient, I can see my estimated waiting time so that I know whether I can step out (judging: user value).
acceptance: Given 3 WAITING Visits ahead and an average visit of 10 minutes today, when the patient opens their Visit, then it shows "ok. 30 min"

backend: `estimatedWaitMinutes` in `VisitResponse`, computed from today's CALLED -> DONE durations
frontend: Waiting time on the check-in confirmation view, refreshed every 30 s
